comments.text: If you are on Windows, VS 2015 and the upcoming VS 2016 have lots of improvements regarding compile times. [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] Apple is also doing a similar work regarding incremental C and C++ builds, based on the work they did for Swift [VIDEO] C++ builds can be made bearable if you don't go crazy with template meta-programming, do forward declarations, only expose actually public data on the headers, instantiate most use templates. But specially do use binary libraries, even across application modules. Don't spend endless time recompiling code that doesn't change.
